## 2. TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE MATRIX

| Surface Material | Mohs Hardness | Water Absorption (%) | Heat Limit | Turmeric (Haldi) Resistance | Primary Recommended Use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Specta Quartz** | 7.0 | < 0.03% | 150 deg C | High (Wipes clean with water/soap) | Kitchen platforms, breakfast islands |
| **Nano White G5/G7** | 6.5 | 0.00% | 300 deg C | Immune (Zero porosity glass) | Pure white minimalist countertops |
| **Steel Grey Granite** | 6.5 | < 0.20% | 350 deg C | Excellent (Wipes clean) | Heavy-duty Indian cooking & stairs |
| **Black Galaxy Granite** | 6.5 | < 0.15% | 350 deg C | Excellent (Immune to acids) | Kitchen counters & TV feature walls |
| **Italian Statuario Marble** | 3.5 | 0.40 - 0.80% | Sensitive | Requires sealing (Porpus calcite) | Living room flooring & master baths |
| **Vitrified Tiles (GVT)** | 6.0 | < 0.05% | 250 deg C | High (Stain resistant glaze) | Master bedrooms & bathroom floors |

## 3. KISHANGARH VS JAIPUR LANDED COST AUDIT

Homeowners often consider traveling 100 km to Kishangarh for Italian marble. Here is the landed cost comparison for a 2,000 sq. ft. villa order:
1. **Quoted Rate**: Kishangarh headline quotes may appear 5% to 8% lower on paper than local Jaipur stockyard quotes.
2. **Freight & Insurance**: Kishangarh to Jaipur inter-district truck freight, tolls, and union surcharges add substantial highway transit overhead.
3. **Transit Breakage**: Transporting 18mm unreinforced gangsaw slabs on national highway causes 3% to 7% hairline cracking with zero return coverage.
4. **Hydraulic Crane Offloading**: Arranging hydraulic crane offloading and specialized site labor adds coordination overhead at residential sites.
5. **Dry-Lay Layout Verification**: In Kishangarh, buyers inspect vertical lots. At Aashiyana Decor Jaipur, buyers dry-lay consecutive slabs horizontally on the showroom floor, guaranteeing zero diamond-pattern mismatches.
6. **Net Result**: Buying in Jaipur from Aashiyana Decor saves 10% to 18% in landed net expenditure while providing zero-breakage replacement guarantee.
